# `codes.grow.packages:infisical` — agent quickstart (Java 17+)

Ships inside the jar at `META-INF/grow/infisical/AGENTS.md`
(`unzip -p infisical-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/infisical/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/infisical/ · Service: Infisical · Categories: secrets ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.infisical`.

## Client

```java
try (InfisicalClient client = InfisicalClient.fromEnv()) { // GROW_INFISICAL_* > vendor env > defaults
  client.health();
}
```

Errors: `InfisicalException` subclasses (`ConfigException`, `NotFoundException`, …) with `code()`.

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```java
import codes.grow.packages.infisical.secrets.ConfigLoader;
Map<String, String> config =
    ConfigLoader.load(ConfigLoader.LoadOptions.builder().required("DATABASE_URL").build());
```

- `ConfigLoader.load(LoadOptions)` / `load()` → `Map<String, String>`; Java cannot change the process
  environment, so values go to **system properties** (or `LoadOptions.target(BiConsumer)`); Spring reads
  system properties.
- Bootstrap: `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `infisical`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`, `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`. Missing required keys
  → `NotFoundException`. No bootstrap or `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` → only the required check.
- Also: `ConfigLoader.loadFrom(provider, path, options)`, `readBootstrap(env)`, `secretsPreloaded(env)`.
